reviewer: Codex implementation audit under the authorized release task
scope: Source payload/retention review with regression checks; not a certification of all live user journeys. Original expired default remains; source or dependency changes invalidate this evidence.

src/features/manual/components/Accountin.assessment: A one-tab boolean marker only; no draft, token, or company payload.

src/features/manual/hooks/useManualStart.assessment: Opaque report ID with completion marker or a five-minute reservation timestamp; session only. Re-reviewed sparse-assessment admission: missing financial inputs may now start, but neither submitted form values nor assessment results enter storage. Failures clear the reservation; the existing review expiry is unchanged.

src/lib/analytics.ts.assessment: One-tab boolean per event and validated resolution hash; no financial payload.

src/utils/journeyTrace.ts.assessment: A validated random journey UUID only; grants no access and contains no identity or figures.

src/utils/silverfin-oauth-state.ts.assessment: One-use callback nonce consumed before comparison, strict finite ten-minute expiry. No provider access/refresh token is persisted.

src/components/AuthGate.tsx.assessment: Prevents redirect loops inside one browser tab.

src/components/calculator/venus-ai-dock-.assessment: Stores only the resizable AI dock width in pixels.

src/config/features.ts.assessment: Keeps rollout bucket stable without user/company payloads.

src/features/manual/hooks/useManualNorma.assessment: Avoids reopening the same non-authoritative modal in one tab.

src/features/startup-studio/components/P.assessment: Restores the active startup preset chip during tab navigation.

src/features/startup-studio/components/S.assessment: Stores only a one-tab co-pilot snooze marker.

src/hooks/useEmbeddedMode.ts.assessment: Preserves embedded-mode routing context in one browser tab.

src/hooks/panelResizeModel.ts.assessment: Centralizes numeric panel-width preference persistence for calculator layouts.

src/hooks/useReportIdTracking.ts.assessment: Keeps report context stable across remounts in one tab.

src/lib/auth/initGuards.ts.assessment: Prevents auth initialization reload loops without storing tokens.

src/lib/auth/initializeAuth.ts.assessment: Safe Mercury return URL and source only in session storage; destination allowlist checked before write. Cookie/session authorization independent.

src/services/cache/businessTypesCache.ts.assessment: Public reference catalog only; bounded 24-hour envelope with finite/future-date validation. Aggregate hit/miss statistics have a non-sensitive lifetime exemption.

src/store/manual/useStartupValuationStor.assessment: Replaced indefinite local draft with validated session recovery (24 hours, 100 kB), exact resolved user/client scope, cold-auth deferral and account/client-change clearing. Backend session remains durable authority.

src/store/useVersionHistoryStore.ts.assessment: Removed all version content, company identity, figures, reports and arbitrary spreads from persistence. Only ten report/version selections, bounded in-session TTL and full resolved user/client scope.

src/stores/clientContext.ts.assessment: Typed display/navigation fields only. Rehydration rejects malformed, future, expired and URL-mismatched context; local checks cannot extend server freshness. Titan verifies delegated headers independently.

src/utils/auth/cross-tab-refresh.ts.assessment: A timestamp only; rejects/removes nonfinite, future, and >=one-hour-old entries. Four-minute dedupe is not an authorization decision.

src/utils/auth/sessionSync.ts.assessment: Broadcast message contains event type/domain/timestamp and optional opaque user ID only; local signal removed after 100 ms. No token or profile data.

src/utils/browserRecoveryStorage.ts.assessment: Central classified envelope enforces maximum 24-hour retention, finite timestamps, expiry/ordering checks, byte bounds and malformed removal. Legacy normalization/tax callers consume entries immediately; signup legacy also has its own finite bounded timestamp.

src/utils/capitalHistoryPrefill.ts.assessment: One-shot session handoff of two finite numeric fields and fixed source; always consumed before parse/restore, no company identity or report assets.

src/utils/newValuationPrefillStorage.ts.assessment: One-shot tab prefill bounded to 500 kB on write; company fingerprint prevents cross-company restoration, identity/HTML/results removed. Legacy path strips identity. Form input continuity, not durable storage.

src/utils/reportExistenceCache.ts.assessment: Only existence booleans; exact user/client scope in key, finite timestamp validation and thirty-minute expiry. Server report access remains mandatory.

src/utils/reportIdentityPromotion.ts.assessment: Only Titan-confirmed session-key/report-UUID aliases keyed by full user/client scope; UUID validated. No valuation or user profile payload, no access grant.

src/utils/sessionCacheManager.ts.assessment: Writes explicit session metadata only (no names, sessionData, partialData, HTML, valuation or buyer-readiness payload); user/client-keyed, twenty entries, enforced finite 24-hour timestamps.

src/utils/workflowRecoveryStorage.ts.assessment: Reviewed common adapter: central TTL, typed snapshots, 100 kB, session-only, legacy local deletion, no read/write before identity resolution, stale update removal on failed writes.

src/services/businessTypeSuggestionApi.t.assessment: Removed user IDs and context. Fifty labels limited to 500 characters; envelope and individual entry age both bounded to 24 hours; unbounded legacy entries rejected.

src/utils/landingStudioHandoff.ts.assessment: Replaced arbitrary form snapshot with explicit startup/company-form field projection; one-shot 24-hour/100 kB recovery. Rejects malformed/future/expired entries including legacy timestamped envelopes. Company form identity is intentional signup context, never user authorization.

src/features/manual/utils/accountingReco.assessment: One thirty-minute draft with sanitized form fields, provider/client/report binding, byte bound, state validation and consumption after resume. OAuth nonce is correlation, not provider credentials.

src/store/useNormalizationStore.ts.assessment: Central 24-hour pending-normalization recovery keyed by report. Arrays filtered through item validator and consumed on read; use after authenticated session restoration. No auth material or report assets produced by writer.

src/store/useTaxLatencyStore.ts.assessment: Central 24-hour pending-tax recovery keyed by report. Entries canonicalized and consumed on read after session restoration; no report assets or authorization decisions.

src/lib/posthog-init.ts.assessment: Both capture and persistence opt out by default; SDK-consented persistence only. Scrubbed event properties, 50-entry memory queues, no autocapture or recordings; unknown SDK consent state fails closed.
